description: This vertical bar chart illustrates the performance metric "Recall@10" across four different model configurations. The horizontal category axis displays the configurations in the following order: "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking", with the text labels slightly rotated. The vertical value axis, which lacks an explicit label but corresponds to the chart's title, represents the score on a linear scale ranging from a minimum of 0.1 to a maximum of 0.4, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1. The chart contains four individual bars corresponding to each category. The first bar, labeled "Ours", is colored brown and represents the highest value on the chart at approximately 0.35; it is visually emphasized by its distinct color compared to the other bars. The remaining three bars are all colored dark slate blue. The "- critiquing" bar has a value of approximately 0.29, the "- scoring" bar is the shortest in the chart with a value of roughly 0.17, and the "- ranking" bar shows a value of about 0.23. The bars are not sorted in a strictly ascending or descending order, and horizontal grid lines are present at the 0.2, 0.3, and 0.4 marks to assist in reading the bar heights.
